subject: JUSTIFIED clause
notes: "When the JUSTIFIED clause is omitted, the standard rules for aligning data within an elementary item apply (see 14.6.8 ...)" (cite.py --check 13.18.32.4 -> OK §13.18.32.4 3); --check 14.6.8 "Alignment" -> OK). StrStoreAligned(justified:false) routes to the standard left-justified StrStore; the boolean store passes justifiedRight from the item flag. Probes: P1 A5 PIC X(5) (no JUSTIFIED) <- "AB" = [AB   ]; P10 PIC N(4) <- N"XY" = [XY  ], PIC 1(4) <- B"11" = [1100] — left alignment with right space/zero fill per §14.6.8, across alphanumeric, national and boolean. The substance of §14.6.8 is owned by its own rows; this row only requires that absence of JUSTIFIED leaves the standard rules in force, which holds. No test names this rule -> test-ref empty.
